entries.zh: 这个文明正逐步迈进全新的科技纪元。
entries.en: This civilization is progressing to a new technological age.

entries.zh: 一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[Target.GetName]上。由于没有天生的免疫力，也没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
entries.en: A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [Target.GetName]. Without natural immunity or the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

entries.zh: 无论哪种形式，这场疫情终究会结束的。但是灾疫之后是什么样，则取决于我们的选择。
entries.en: One way or another, this plague will end. What is left in the aftermath may well depend on us.

entries.zh: $preftl.2001.can_help.desc$\n\n我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是当这些人受苦的时候，我们真的可以袖手旁观吗？
entries.en: $preftl.2001.can_help.desc$\n\nOur policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds, but can we really stand idly by while these people suffer?

entries.zh: 一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上。由于没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
entries.en: A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Without the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

entries.zh: 我们将疾病投放到毫无戒心的民众中，现在疫情已经扩散到我们无法控制的程度。由于没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
entries.en: The disease we introduced to an unsuspecting population has spread beyond our control. Without the medical technology required to combat the infection, the planet's people are quickly succumbing to misery and death.

entries.zh: 观察这样的局势应该能为我们提供一些有趣的见解。一旦选定，我们将无法改变针对该局势的应对方案。
entries.en: Observing this situation should provide some interesting insights. Once selected, we will be unable to change this approach.
It is too late to switch our approach.

entries.zh: 为有需要的人提供帮助是我们义不容辞的责任。一旦选定，我们将无法改变针对该局势的应对方案。
entries.en: It is our responsibility to help those in need. Once selected, we will be unable to change this approach.

entries.zh: 瘟疫提供了我们一个绝佳的进行研究的机会，我们甚至有机会一口气净化整个行星上的感性生命体。一旦选定，我们将无法改变针对该局势的应对方案。
entries.en: The plague offers a unique opportunity for research, and perhaps even the chance to purge the planet of sentient life. Once selected, we will be unable to change this approach.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人畜共患疾病继续蔓延。到现在，这个行星上的大多数主要定居点都被感染了。随着死亡率的不断上升，这场灾难的泛滥
entries.en: The zoonotic disease on [Target.GetName] continues to spread. By now, most of the planet's major settlements have been infected. As mortality rates continue to rise, the sheer scale of the disaster

entries.zh: $preftl.2006.desc.intro$又引发了宗教内部的派系分裂，以及末日邪教的爆炸性扩散。
entries.en: $preftl.2006.desc.intro$ has resulted in an explosive proliferation of religious sects and apocalyptic cults.
Guide them to the true faith.

entries.zh: 在最严酷的时期，迷失之徒在精神上寻找慰藉。
entries.en: In the most challenging times, those who are lost find solace in the spirit.

entries.zh: $preftl.2006.desc.intro$是史无前例的。毫不奇怪的是，由于权力的真空，无数军阀趁势而起。
entries.en: $preftl.2006.desc.intro$ is unprecedented. Perhaps unsurprisingly, numerous warlords have arisen to fill the power vacuum.

entries.zh: 我们帮助防止疾病在[Target.GetName]上传播的所作所为并非没有引起他人的注意：当地居民已经开始谈论“天使”，认定这些开明的存在已经出现在他们中间，提供心灵安慰，并帮助人们摆脱痛苦。
entries.en: Our efforts to help prevent the spread of disease on [Target.GetName] have not gone unnoticed: the local population has begun to speak of 'angels', enlightened beings who have appeared among them to offer comfort and deliverance.

entries.zh: 类似这样的事情注定会发生。
entries.en: Something like this was bound to happen.

entries.zh: 我们在[Target.GetName]上遏制瘟疫蔓延的所作所为引起了人们的注意：当地居民开始谈论“恶魔”，认定有一些不神圣的生物出现在他们中间，用亵渎的魔法对抗疾病。
entries.en: Our work to contain the spread of the plague on [Target.GetName] is attracting attention: the local population has begun to speak of 'demons', unholy beings who have appeared among them to combat the disease using profane magic.

entries.zh: 我们在[Target.GetName]上促进瘟疫传播的努力现在产生了一定的成果。通过对当地食物来源进行多处污染，传染病正在大肆蔓延。到目前为止，这颗星球上的每一个定居点都被感染了，而活着的人太虚弱，根本无法对死者进行处理。
entries.en: Our efforts to promote the plague on [Target.GetName] are bearing fruit. Through discrete contamination of local food sources, the contagion is running rampant. By now, every settlement on the planet has been infected, and the living are too weak to dispose of the dead.

entries.zh: 够了。这样的苦难必须终止。
终止瘟疫会暴露我们的存在，还需要投入大量的资源。
entries.en: Ending the plague now will reveal our presence and require a significant investment of resources.

entries.zh: 在一场灾难性的大瘟疫中全球的人口消亡殆尽，所剩的只有沉默地延伸向天际的无边旷野。这片死寂的空白中，只有无数的游魂在飘荡。
entries.en: After a cataclysmic plague decimated the global population, all that remains is a silent expanse that stretches towards the horizon. An empty landscape, occupied by countless lost souls.

entries.zh: 我们在[Target.GetName]上散布瘟疫的工作已经取得了成果。瘟疫横行，死人被随意丢在街上任凭腐烂。\n\n然而，相当比例的人口拥有对该疾病的自然免疫力。对他们基因组的进一步研究可能对我们自己的免疫学研究有帮助。
entries.en: Our efforts to promote the plague on [Target.GetName] have borne fruit. The contagion is running rampant, and the dead are left to fester in the streets.\n\nHowever, a significant percentage of the population possesses a natural immunity to the disease. Further study of their genome could be useful in our own immunology research.

entries.zh: 继续提供帮助的同时还要遮掩我们的真实本质，这需要投入极大量的资源。
entries.en: Continuing to help while concealing our true nature will require a significant investment of resources.

entries.zh: 人们继续口口相传着在[Target.GetName]上工作的奇迹“天使”。难民们已经来到我们的医疗保障供应处，吵着寻求援助。$preftl.2020.name.outro$
entries.en: Word continues to spread of the miraculous 'angels' at work on [Target.GetName]. Refugees have descended on our healthcare providers, clamoring for aid. $preftl.2020.name.outro$

entries.zh: 人们继续口口相传着在[Target.GetName]上工作的“恶魔”。狂热信徒已经来到我们的医疗保障供应处，吵着寻求[Root.GetBloodType]的供应。$preftl.2020.name.outro$
entries.en: Word continues to spread of the 'demons' at work on [Target.GetName]. Fanatics have descended on our healthcare providers, clamoring for [Root.GetBloodType]. $preftl.2020.name.outro$

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]出现了许多所谓的救世主。这些先知承诺“神圣的救赎”，进而吸引了大批追随者。在疾病肆虐的基础上，相互竞争的教派之间产生的暴力冲突也越来越普遍。
entries.en: On [Target.GetName], a number of so-called messiahs have appeared. With promises of 'divine deliverance', each of these prophets has amassed a substantial following. On top of the ravages of disease, violent clashes between competing sects are increasingly commonplace.

entries.zh: 通往圣识的道路是曲折的。
entries.en: The path of divine truth is winding.

entries.zh: 终于，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫走到了尽头，我们在那里的工作得到了回报：幸存者们团结在一位真信的先知周围。为了表示感谢，神职部门愿意向我们派遣一名工作上的使者，据说他作为行政官的能力是非常强大的。
entries.en: At last, the plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course, and our work there has been rewarded: the survivors have rallied around a prophet of the true faith. In gratitude, the priesthood is willing to provide us with a working emissary, whose skills as an official are said to be formidable.

entries.zh: 又一个社会唤醒了真正的信仰。我们的启示会响彻整个星系。
entries.en: Another society has awakened to the true faith. Our message rings out across the galaxy.

entries.zh: 在这个严酷的星系中，又有一颗行星拥有了自卫的能力。
entries.en: Another planet in this harsh galaxy is now capable of defending themselves.

entries.zh: 一名能力出众的行政官同意加入我们帝国。
entries.en: A skilled Official agrees to join our empire.

entries.zh: 尽管凝视过深渊，但这位领袖的信仰从不曾动摇。
entries.en: Having gazed into the abyss, this leader possesses unshakeable faith.

entries.zh: 尽管凝视过深渊，但这位领袖的信仰从不曾动摇。
entries.en: Having gazed into the abyss, this leader possesses unshakeable faith.

entries.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，人们筋疲力尽、遭受饥馑和疾病，因为苦难和无尽的战争濒临崩溃，曲曲折折地缓步迈向一个不确定的未来。
entries.en: On [Target.GetName], the exhausted population, starving, sick, half-mad with grief and endless war, staggers towards an uncertain future.

entries.zh: 当天灾成为常态，罹难者不战则亡。
entries.en: When crisis becomes routine, the victims either fight or fall.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫已经走到了尽头，我们支持的派系已经成功地将全体人民统一在同一面旗帜下。为了感谢我们所作的工作，执政的军政府提出向我们派遣一名指挥官，此人的战争艺术已被饱经淬炼。
entries.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course, and the faction we backed has succeeded in uniting the population under a single banner. In gratitude for our efforts, the ruling junta has offered to provide us with a commander, one whose skills on the battlefield have proven formidable.

entries.zh: 一名能力出众的指挥官同意加入我们帝国。
entries.en: A skilled Commander agrees to join our empire.

entries.zh: 尽管凝视过深渊，但这位指挥官却能做到为人热情，温润如玉。
entries.en: Having gazed into the abyss, this commander possesses a keen and tempered mind.

entries.zh: 由于我们行动迅速的散布，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫已经使人口所剩无几。那些幸存的少数人亲眼目睹着他们文明的崩溃。现在只需要轻轻的一脚，就可以将他们推下悬崖。\n\n我们已经准备好继承一个空旷的星球。
entries.en: Thanks to our fastidious promotion, the plague on [Target.GetName] has decimated the population. Those few who survive now face the collapse of their civilization. Pushing them over the brink should not require much effort.\n\nWe are poised to inherit an empty world.

entries.zh: 我们从[Target.GetName]上获得的样本已经有了科学方面的回报；这种突变不仅能够提供对瘟疫的免疫力，还能抵御大多数已知形式的传染。\n\n将这项研究转化为生产应用还需要时间，但初步的结果已经相当令人鼓舞。
entries.en: The sample we obtained from [Target.GetName] has already paid scientific dividends; the mutation that provides immunity against the plague appears capable of warding off most known forms of contagion.\n\nIt will take time to apply this research, but the initial results are more than encouraging.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上瞬息万变的局势让我们无法继续监视正在进行的瘟疫。到目前为止，该行星上的所有研究项目都中断了。
entries.en: The swiftly changing circumstances on [Target.GetName] have made it impossible for us to continue monitoring the ongoing plague. For the time being, all research research projects on the planet must be shelved.

entries.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上，低沉的风吹过空荡荡的平原。一度住满全家老小的房屋，现在已了无生机，凄凉无比。
entries.en: On [Target.GetName], winds whisper across the empty plains. Dwellings that once housed whole families now stand lifeless and forlorn.

entries.zh: $preftl.2063.intro$\n\n这颗行星上的人口已经被消灭殆尽。最终，疫情完成了自己的使命。
entries.en: $preftl.2063.intro$\n\nThe planet's population has been eliminated. At long last, the plague has run its course.

entries.zh: $preftl.2063.intro$我们的工作完成了：[Target.GetName]上的人口已经彻底消灭殆尽，这颗星球随时等待我们夺取。
entries.en: $preftl.2063.intro$ Our work is done: the population of [Target.GetName] has been eliminated, and the planet is ours for the taking.

entries.zh: 随着疫情继续肆虐[Target.GetName]，死者和正在死去的人的数目令人震惊。\n\n这种疫病没有治愈手段。人们遭受的痛苦只能减缓，无法避免。
entries.en: As the plague continues to ravage [Target.GetName], the number of dead and dying is staggering.\n\nThere is no cure. Further suffering can only be alleviated, not prevented.

entries.zh: 我们对[Target.GetName]瘟疫所作的对策已经再也藏不住了。民众现在将他们悲痛的目光转向了天上的星辰。我们已经让他们彻底敞开了思想，直面真相；接下来会发生什么，我们拭目以待。
entries.en: Our response to the plague on [Target.GetName] can no longer be concealed. The population now turns their grief-stricken gaze to the stars. We have opened their minds to the truth; what happens next remains to be seen.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]的人们对我们的评价提高了。
entries.en: The people of [Target.GetName] have an increased opinion of us.

entries.zh: 终于，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫走到了尽头。先知的年代已经终结，一批主流的宗教开始蓬勃发展。随着人们对意义感有了新的任务，对星球的重建工作也开始有序开展。
entries.en: At last, the plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course. The age of prophets has come to an end, and a number of major religions are flourishing. With a renewed sense of meaning, the people have begun to rebuild.

entries.zh: 终于，[Target.GetName]上的瘟疫走到了尽头。军阀的年代已经终结，一批战士社会开始蓬勃发展。出于对能活下来的感激之情，人们开始希望领袖们能够施加强有力和有决断力的统治。
entries.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has run its course. The age of warlords has come to an end, and a number of warrior societies are flourishing. Grateful to be alive, the people look to their leaders for strong and determined rule.

entries.zh: 通过孜孜不倦的努力，我们已经成功地遏制了瘟疫对[Target.GetName]能造成的最坏影响。然而，我们存在于这颗星球上的真实本质再也无法掩盖了。人们明白他们是被另一颗星球所拯救。他们充满了感激之情，将目光转向了星空。
entries.en: Through diligent effort, we have succeeded in curbing the worst effects of the plague on [Target.GetName]. However, the true nature of our presence on the planet can no longer be concealed. The population understands they have been saved by another world. Filled with gratitude, they turn their gaze to the stars.

entries.zh: 挽救整颗星球，值得歌舞升平。
entries.en: Saving an entire planet is worth celebrating.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]的人们对我们的评价提高了。
entries.en: The people of [Target.GetName] have an increased opinion of us.

entries.zh: 瘟疫对[Target.GetName]能够造成的最严重的影响已经得到控制。然而，幸存者非但没有感激之情，反而对前来污染他们文化的“恶魔般的外来者”充满了义愤填膺。我们的救助人员遭到了针对和污蔑，因此被迫放弃了这个行星。虽然还没有完全意识到真相，但当地居民现在把紧张的目光转向了头顶的星辰。
entries.en: The worst effects of the plague on [Target.GetName] have been contained. However, far from gratitude, the survivors are filled with righteous anger at the 'demonic outsiders' who arrived to pollute their culture. Targeted and stigmatized, our aid workers have been forced to abandon the planet. While not yet fully aware of the truth, the local population now turns a nervous gaze to the stars.

entries.zh: 那些玩意宁肯闭门造车，也不肯接受我们的福泽，反而还嗤之以鼻，今后我们应当更多地关注自身。
entries.en: Having been spurned by beings who would rather live in their own ignorance than accept our aid, in future we shall focus more on ourselves.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]的人们对我们的评价降低了。
entries.en: The people of [Target.GetName] have a lowered opinion of us.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫终于走到了尽头。更重要的是，我们对人群免疫力增强的研究已经完成，现在必须做出选择：这项研究的成果应该仅应用于我们的统治阶层，还是全体民众？增加我们领袖的寿命当然是一个有吸引力的方案，但心怀感激的民众也有自己的好处。
entries.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has finally run its course. More importantly, our study of the population's enhanced immunity is complete, and a choice must now be made: should the benefits of this research be applied exclusively to our ruling class, or the population as a whole? Increasing the longevity of our leaders is certainly attractive, while a grateful populace carries blessings of its own.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫终于走到了尽头。更重要的是，我们对人群免疫力增强的研究已经完成。这样的知识当然是有益的，但现在必须做出选择：这项研究的成果应该仅应用于我们的领袖阶层，还是集体中的每一个子个体？
entries.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has finally run its course. More importantly, our study of the population's enhanced immunity is complete. This knowledge will certainly be of benefit, but a choice must be made: should we apply it exclusively to our leaders, or to every drone in the collective?

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上的瘟疫终于走到了尽头。更重要的是，我们对人群免疫力增强的研究已经完成。这样的知识可以给[Owner.GetName]带来好处。
entries.en: The plague on [Target.GetName] has finally run its course. More importantly, our study of the population's enhanced immunity is complete. This knowledge can now be applied to benefit the [Owner.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们的领袖能够长盛不衰。
我们的人民要放在首位。
[Target.GetName]上的人们偶然发现了一个新型的物种。这是一种具有处理复杂行动的能力的节点意识，与这种生物的开展互动最终可能会导致有机奇点的出现。
entries.en: The people on [Target.GetName] have stumbled across a new type of species. A nodal consciousness with the ability to handle complex operations, interacting with this creature may eventually result in the advent of an Organic Singularity.

entries.zh: 我们选择的应对方案将会决定这个§Y局势§!的进展速率。
entries.en: Our choice of approach will determine the rate of progress for this §YSituation§!.

entries.zh: 观测这个发展过程应该能提供一些有趣的线索。
entries.en: Watching this unfold should provide some interesting insights.

entries.zh: 一旦我们决定了应对方案，我们就无法再更改。
entries.en: Once our initial approach has been determined, we are unable to change it.

entries.zh: 预防奇点的出现需要持续地投入资源。一旦选择这个应对方案，我们今后就无法再进行变更。
entries.en: Preventing the Singularity will require a continuous investment in resources. Once selected, we will be unable to change this approach.

entries.zh: 鼓励奇点的出现需要投入大量资源。一旦选择这个应对方案，我们今后就无法再进行变更。
entries.en: Promoting the Singularity will require a significant investment.  Once selected, we will be unable to change this approach.

entries.zh: [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的探险家在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上发现了一种以前未曾见识过的软体类物种。就其本身而言，这些生物中的每一个都只能勉强算得上是有智慧的。然而，当两个或更多的生物个体通过身体接触结合在一起时，它们会形成一个半意识的节点。理论上，这些节点应该能够在认知能力方面有指数级的增长。\n\n简单地说，[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]的人们偶然发现了一种生物思维机器。假以时日，这一发现可能预示着有机奇点的到来。
entries.en: [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] explorers on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have discovered a previously unknown species of molluscoid. On its own, each of these creatures barely qualifies as sapient. However, when two or more are joined through physical contact, they form a semi-conscious node. Theoretically, these nodes should be capable of an exponential growth in cognitive power.\n\nSimply put, the people of [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have stumbled onto a biological thinking machine. Given time, this discovery could herald the advent of an Organic Singularity.

entries.zh: $preftl.2101.desc$\n\n我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是我们真的能够什么都不做，只在一边看着吗？
entries.en: $preftl.2101.desc$\n\nOur policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds, but can we really afford to stand by and watch?

entries.zh:
[Target.GetName]的居民没有意识到迫在眉睫的危险，继续试验最近发现的节点意识，将其计算结果用于从建筑到教育的各个方面。

减缓他们的进展是很困难的一件事，但是通过在行星的水循环中引入一种经过基因强化的病毒，我们应该能够减少单个节点的认知能力。

当然，与任何未经测试的技术一样，这么做存在着未知的风险。
entries.en:
Unaware of the looming danger, the inhabitants of [Target.GetName] continue to experiment with the recently discovered nodal consciousness, making use of its calculations in everything from architecture to education.

Slowing their progress will be difficult, but by introducing a genetically-augmented virus into the planet's water cycle, we should be able to reduce the cognitive power of the individual nodes.

Of course, as with any untested technology, there are unknown risks.

entries.zh: 通过坚持不懈的试验，[Target.GetName]的人民已经开始使用最近发现的节点意识作为基本的思考机器。\n\n现在，这些居民能够完成复杂的数学计算，正以前所未有的速度在科学和技术方面取得突破。
entries.en: Through persistent experimentation, the people of [Target.GetName] have begun to use the recently discovered nodal consciousness as a rudimentary thinking machine.\n\nNow capable of completing complex mathematical calculations, the inhabitants are making breakthroughs in science and technology at a previously unheard of pace.

entries.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上实现有机奇点的进展十分迅速。\n\n节点意识已经重新组织了星球上的大部分农业生产，提高了作物产量，改善了生活条件。人们已经开始把他们的决策权委任给生物机器了。
entries.en: Progress towards an Organic Singularity on [Target.GetName] continues apace.\n\nThe nodal consciousness has reorganized much of the planet's agricultural production, increasing crop yields and raising standards of living. Already, the people are relinquishing their decision-making to the biological machine.

entries.zh: 观测行星上的生活条件得到了翻天覆地的改善。
entries.en: Living conditions on the observed planet will substantially improve.

entries.zh: 我们在[Target.GetName]上的特工已经将修改过的病毒引入了该行星的水系统。初步报告显示，结点意识的处理能力明显下降。\n\n不幸的是，我们的所作所为引起了注意：一些居民开始低声议论“外部”在施加影响。
entries.en: Our agents on [Target.GetName] have introduced the modified virus to the planet's water system. Initial reports indicate a marked reduction in the processing power of the nodal consciousness.\n\nUnfortunately, our efforts have not gone unnoticed: some of the inhabitants are beginning to whisper about 'outside' influences.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上的节点意识的接口已达到饱和点。所有的官僚决策都被委托给这个有机的蜂巢意识，其成果是相当瞩目的。\n\n这个行星的经济正在蓬勃发展，人们如今实现的生活水平，上一代人甚至想都无法想象得到。
entries.en: Interface with the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] is reaching a saturation point. All bureaucratic decisions have been delegated to the organic hive mind, and the results are nothing short of spectacular.\n\nThe planet's economy is booming, and the people have achieved a standard of life that would have been unthinkable even a generation ago.

entries.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上，高等水平的意识出现了第一次悸动。然而，很明显，这个节点意识可能有自己的规划宏图。

为了努力“精简”流程，某些基本设施已经被削减。曾经由人工完成的工作越来越自动化，而当地政府发现自己无法（或不愿意）阻止变化的浪潮。

许多居民对他们的星球正在发生的事情越来越感到不安。
entries.en:
The first stirrings of an advanced level of consciousness have appeared on [Target.GetName]. However, it has become obvious that the nodal consciousness may have its own designs.

In an effort to 'streamline' processes, certain basic amenities have been curtailed. Jobs that were once done by hand are increasingly automated, and local government has found itself unable (or unwilling) to stem the tide of change.

Many of the inhabitants are increasingly uneasy about what is taking place on their world.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上的节点意识的增长已经稳定下来。现在很清楚，奇点不会在这颗星球上实现。\n\n然而，快速的技术变革已经将[Target.GetName]提升到完全的超光速状态。政府特工旋即夺取了星系并拆除了我们的观察站。
entries.en: The growth of the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] has stabilized. It is clear now that the Singularity will not be achieved on this world.\n\nHowever, rapid technological change has elevated [Target.GetName] to full FTL status. Government agents wasted no time in seizing the system and dismantling our Observation Post.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上的节点意识的增长已经稳定下来。技术和社会生活的进步已经从以前的飞速发展中放缓。\n\n现在很清楚，奇点不会在这颗星球上实现——相反，一个完全相互联系的社会已经发展起来，而且这是一个享有广泛的健康和其他物质利益的社会。
entries.en: The growth of the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] has stabilized, and advances in technology and social life have slowed from their formerly breakneck pace.\n\nIt is clear now that the Singularity will not be achieved on this world - instead, a fully interconnected society has developed, and one that enjoys widespread health and other material benefits.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上的文明在科技和社会进步方面达到了全新的层次。
entries.en: The civilization on [Target.GetName] has advanced to a new level of technological and social progress.

entries.zh: 我们对星系的所有权不容忽视。
entries.en: Our claim to the system cannot be ignored.

entries.zh: 这是他们文明伟大的一天。
entries.en: A great day for their civilization.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上出现了奇点。\n\n经过多年的指数式增长，今天节点意识已经彻底获得了心智，并不失时机地巩固了其权威。随着行星上的人们沦为傀儡状态，大部分人已被迫屈从。他们现在只为蜂巢思维效力了。
entries.en: The Singularity has arisen on [Target.GetName].\n\nAfter years of exponential growth, today the nodal consciousness achieved full sapience and wasted no time solidifying its authority. With the planet's population reduced to puppet status, many have been forced into subservience. They now exist to provide for the hive.

entries.zh: 我们在[Target.GetName]上促进奇点形成的工作已经得到了回报。\n\n到目前为止，整个行星几乎完全网络化了，大部分的日常决策都交给了节点意识。然而，为了“精简”流程，某些基本设施已经被取消了，行星上的人们越来越清楚地看到，他们的软体类机器可能有自己的规划宏图。
entries.en: Our work to promote the Singularity on [Target.GetName] is already paying dividends.\n\nBy now, the planet is almost entirely networked, with much of the day-to-day decision-making given over to the nodal consciousness. However, in an effort to 'streamline' processes, certain basic amenities have been eliminated, and it is growing increasingly clear to the planet's people that their molluscoid machine may have its own designs.

entries.zh: 我们对[Target.GetName]上的节点意识进行了基因修饰，这导致这个物种无法继续作为高级智能的载体。
entries.en: Our genetic modification of the nodal consciousness on [Target.GetName] has rendered the species useless as a vector for advanced intelligence.

entries.zh: $preftl.2150.intro$可以肯定的是，奇点已经被阻止了。\n\n虽然当地居民中仍然有许多人继续使用互联的软体动物进行计算，但其他人已经发现，这些生物是极好的蛋白质来源。
entries.en: $preftl.2150.intro$ It is safe to conclude that the Singularity has been prevented.\n\nWhile many in the local population continue to use the linked molluscoids for calculation, others have found that the creatures make excellent source of protein.

entries.zh: $preftl.2150.intro$不幸的是，在供水中引入一种新的病毒的举措产生了意想不到的并发症，首先蔓延到当地的动物群，然后蔓延到这颗星球的所有有心智的人口。\n\n虽然我们成功地防止了一个奇点级事件的出现，但毫无疑问，我们已经对一个新兴的社会造成了不可挽回的损失。
entries.en: $preftl.2150.intro$ Unfortunately, the introduction of a novel virus to the water supply has had unexpected complications, first spreading to the local fauna, and then to the planet's sapient population.\n\nWhile a Singularity-level event has been successfully prevented, there is no doubt we have caused irreparable damage to a burgeoning society.

entries.zh: 奇点已经在[Target.GetName]上濒临降生了。在其飞升后的几个小时内，蜂巢思维就已经吸收了行星上90%以上的人口，剩下的少数个体也已经在被追杀。\n\n我们见证了一个奇点意识的诞生。
entries.en: The Singularity has dawned on [Target.GetName]. Within hours of its ascension, the hive mind had absorbed more than 90% of the planet's population, and the few individuals who remain are already being hunted down.\n\nWe stand witness to the birth of a singular consciousness.

entries.zh: [Target.Owner.GetName]已经被转化为一个蜂巢思维。
entries.en: [Target.Owner.GetName] has been converted into a Hive Mind.

entries.zh: 我们一直在监测的局势突然有了结论。\n\n宇宙中唯一不变的是变化。无论好坏，变数早晚会出现。
entries.en: The situation we have been monitoring has come to an abrupt conclusion.\n\nThe only constant in the universe is change. For good or ill, it is only a matter of time before some new development arises.

entries.zh: 多亏了科技的飞速发展，生活水平得到了提升。
entries.en: Thanks to the rapid pace of technological growth, living standards are on the rise.

entries.zh: 尽管它们最终没有发展成为奇点，另一方面，这些思维机器倒是蛮好吃的。
entries.en: While they may not have resulted in a Singularity, these thinking machines have proven surprisingly delicious.

entries.zh: 出于效率的原因，这个行星上的公共事业投资遭到了巨额削减。
entries.en: In the name of efficiency, deep cuts in public investment are being made on on the planet.

entries.zh: 多亏了新近发现的思想机器，研究者们不断产出卓越的科研成果。
entries.en: Thanks to the newly discovered thinking machines, researchers are making extraordinary advances.

entries.zh: 有机奇点已经对人口进行了彻底的控制。
entries.en: The Organic Singularity has assumed total control of the population.

entries.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。
entries.en: Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [Target.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.

entries.zh: 观测这个发展过程应该能提供一些有趣的线索。
entries.en: Watching this unfold should provide some interesting insights.

entries.zh: 协助主要派系的领袖需要投入资源。
entries.en: Aiding the leader of the major faction will require an investment of resources.

entries.zh: 协助主要派系的领袖需要投入大量资源。
entries.en: Aiding the rebels will require an significant investment of resources.

entries.zh: 在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。
entries.en: Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.

entries.zh: $preftl.2167.desc$\n\n我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是我们真的能够什么都不做，只在一边看着吗？
entries.en: $preftl.2167.desc$\n\nOur policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds, but can we really afford to stand by and watch?

entries.zh: 这些爱国者为了守护四分五裂的家园而战。
entries.en: These patriots fight to protect their divided homeland.

entries.zh: 持续的支持将使成功的几率略微增加。
entries.en: Continued support will increase the chances of a successful outcome by a modest percentage.

entries.zh: 提供先进武器将大大提高成功的几率。
entries.en: Providing advanced weaponry will increase the chances of a successful outcome by a significant percentage.

entries.zh: 对于[Target.GetName]的叛军而言，前路渺茫。在[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]鼓舞人心的领导下，护统军已经夺取了星球上大多数人口中心的政权。统一由铁拳铸成。任何异见都被迅速镇压。
entries.en: For the rebels on [Target.GetName], the future appears grim: under the inspired leadership of [Target.Owner.GetRulerName], pro-unification forces have seized power in most of the planet's population centers. Unity is imposed with an iron fist. Any dissent is swiftly crushed.

entries.zh: 增加我们对叛军的援助。
entries.en: Increase our aid to the rebels.

entries.zh: 我们可以增加对护统军的援助。
entries.en: We can do more more to aid the pro-unification forces.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]烽火连天，护统军和叛军继续互相厮杀。在这场斗争中，武器和战术无所不用其极，双方都犯下了累累罪行。
entries.en: Battles rage on [Target.GetName], where pro-unification and rebel forces continue to tear one another to pieces. In this struggle, no weapon or tactic is off-limit, and atrocities have been committed on both sides.

entries.zh: 叛军比以往任何时候都更急需我们的援助。
entries.en: The rebels need our help now more than ever.
Increase support to the pro-unification forces.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上内战频仍，护统军即将取胜。\n\n然而在前线的大后方，当地的官员们却在绞尽脑汁地中饱私囊。目前虽然压制住了异见，但当地民众并非没有注意到腐败问题。
entries.en: As the civil conflict continues to rage on [Target.GetName], pro-unification forces are on the brink of victory.\n\nHowever, far from the front lines, local governors are seizing every opportunity to enrich themselves. For now, criticism remains muted, but the corruption has not gone unnoticed by the local population.

entries.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，护统军和叛军之间的战争已收敛成小打小闹。随着前线的巩固，双方的地方军阀都在通过贪腐来中饱私囊。这对冲突进程的影响，还有待观察。
entries.en: On [Target.GetName], the war between pro-unification and rebel forces has slowed to a murderous grind. With front lines entrenched, local warlords on both sides are enriching themselves by means of graft and corruption. How this will affect the course of the conflict remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 派遣特工，使政权合法化。
entries.en: Have our agents legitimize the regime.

entries.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上，腐败和地方领袖的无能引发了动荡，这促使民众转而支持叛军的事业。\n\n在星球的主要中心城市里，[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]已命令军队逐街开展一系列残酷的镇压行动以铲除异己。
entries.en: The instability caused by corrupt and ineffectual local leaders on [Target.GetName] has galvanized public support around the rebels' cause.\n\nIn the planet's major urban centers, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has ordered their troops to carry out a series of brutal, street-by-street incursions to weed out the resistance.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]上腐败猖獗，领袖无能，打消了民众对战争的支持。双方的将领都被迫开展治安战以压制民众的不满。
entries.en: The increasingly corrupt and ineffectual local leaders on [Target.GetName] have diminished popular support for the war. On both sides, military generals have been forced into anti-insurgency campaigns to quell civilian unrest.

entries.zh:
纵览[Target.GetName]，叛军节节败退，而[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]稳坐江山。

然而，即便新的世界秩序仍在酝酿，但裂痕已然出现。高官与元勋相互倾轧；贪婪的朝臣游走于权力场。

[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]即将在全新的战场上接受考验。
entries.en:
Across [Target.GetName] rebel forces are in retreat, and [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] reigns supreme.

However, even as a new world order is taking shape, fractures have begun to appear; high-ranking officials pit themselves against victorious generals, and profit-hungry courtiers stalk the halls of power.

[Target.Owner.GetRulerName] is about to be tested on a whole new battlefield.

entries.zh: 没有任何一方能掌控[Target.GetName]，这导致整颗星球深陷混乱。地方军阀争权夺利，社会运动此起彼伏。只要星球上旷古未有的动荡不止，和平就只会是黄粱一梦。
entries.en: Given the failure of any one group to seize control of [Target.GetName], the planet has descended into chaos. Local warlords vie for power, and increasingly radical social movements spring up overnight. As the planet continues through the greatest upheaval in its history, peace remains a distant dream.

entries.zh: 厌恶于星球上高官的堕落和腐败，[Target.GetName]的人民已揭竿而起，与叛军同仇敌忾。革命之火在每一座小镇和村庄蔓延。
entries.en: Decrying the decadence and corruption of the planet's highest officials, the people on [Target.GetName] have risen up in solidarity with rebel forces. In every town and village, the fires of revolution burn.

entries.zh:
[Target.GetName]上动荡不安。

涣散的军队在乡间游荡，饥渴难耐。在首都，[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]继续称王，但如日西山，圣旨难出宫门。

除非发生重大转机，否则护统军败局已定。
entries.en:
On [Target.GetName] chaos reigns.

Disorganized bands roam the countryside, desperate for food. In the capital, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] clings to power, but with a diminished authority that barely extends beyond the palace gates.

Unless something radical changes, the pro-unification forces appear headed for defeat.

entries.zh: [Target.Owner.GetRulerName]运筹帷幄，粉碎了星球上的反抗势力。在叛军阵营潜伏的特工发起了一场遍及全球的联合突袭。不等叛军将领回过神来，阵地悉数失守。\n\n[Target.GetName]现在是个大一统的星球。
entries.en: In a stunning display of strategy, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has crushed the planet's resistance. Sleeper agents in the rebel ranks precipitated a coordinated and planet-wide attack. Before the rebel generals knew what was happening, their positions were overwhelmed.\n\n[Target.GetName] is now a unified world.

entries.zh:
事态急转直下，[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]被废黜。

叛军与政权内几个投机的将军结盟，成功地发动了一次遍及全球的联合袭击。不等护统军指挥官回过神来，阵地悉数失守。

[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]戴着镣铐在首都游街示众，旋即被处决。获胜的叛军赋予星球各地自治权。经过多年的战争，脆弱的和平终于降临。
entries.en:
In a stunning turn of events, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has been deposed.

Aligning themselves with several opportunistic generals within the regime, rebel forces succeeded in launching a coordinated, planet-wide attack. Before the pro-unification commanders knew what was happening, their positions were overwhelmed.

Paraded in chains through the streets of the capital, [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] was quickly executed. The victorious rebels have granted the planet's regions the authority to dictate their own affairs. After years of war, a tenuous peace has descended.

entries.zh: [Target.Owner.GetRulerName]被废黜。\n\n这个前军阀戴着镣铐在首都游街示众，旋即被处决。获胜的叛军赋予星球各地自治权。经过多年的战争，脆弱的和平终于降临。
entries.en: [Target.Owner.GetRulerName] has been deposed.\n\nParaded in chains through the streets of the capital, the former warlord was quickly executed. The victorious rebels have granted the planet's regions the authority to dictate their own affairs. After years of war, a tenuous peace has descended.

entries.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们可能会怀念[Target.Owner.GetRulerName]。
entries.en: In time they may come to miss [Target.Owner.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 强权带来统一；统一带来福祉。
entries.en: Strength leads to unity; unity leads to happiness.

entries.zh: 多元社会带来福祉，福祉带来统一。
entries.en: A diverse society leads to happiness. Happiness leads to unity.

entries.zh: 这些资源将迅速且公正地终结冲突。
entries.en: These resources will ensure a swift and just end to the conflict.
